title: Why the US-Israel War on Iran is headed for escalation | The Bottom Line
summary: A former Iranian diplomat and a former US diplomat discuss the stalled US-Israeli war on Iran, expecting Iranian escalation before the US midterms and US strikes after them, with no clear path to a deal.

assertions.quote: it's going to respond to increased pressure eventually, not with capitulation, but with escalation

verdicts.note: Iran met the 2026 attack with escalation (closing Hormuz) and refused to negotiate under fire; whether it would do so again after the ceasefire is untested.

assertions.quote: I think there'll be military strikes from the United States after the midterms

verdicts.note: Polymarket implies about a 71% chance of a US air or missile strike on Iran before the end of 2026, so a US or Israeli strike by early 2027 is priced as likely.

assertions.quote: we could well have increased Iran's desire to actually get a nuclear weapon
the overall volume of crude and refined products has has dropped precipitously
if you're asking me is a diplomatic solution possible now I think the odds are very long

verdicts.note: A short-term forecast about live negotiations, not yet checkable.
A ceasefire was negotiated in April 2026, but the paper calls the prospects of a permanent settlement hard to assess given the wide gap between the two sides' demands.
